thread: maria (prod): quick design callout — re: private setup wizard network step. I sketched a tiny tweak to the status pills. wondering if we should use 'Untested / Testing / Reachable / Failing' or 'Unknown / In progress / Reachable / Unreachable'. Thoughts? :thinking_face: jia (design): i prefer wording that maps to what users understand immediately. 'Untested' vs 'Unknown' — 'Untested' implies they can/should run a check. 'Unknown' feels system-y. lean toward 'Untested / Checking / Reachable / Unreachable'. keeps verbs parallel-ish with Checking. sam (eng): from a backend perspective 'Checking' maps to the probe in-flight state, good. small caveat: we sometimes have partial results (eg. TCP ok but DNS fail). we currently collapse into overall 'Unreachable' which is confusing. can we show a micro-summary tooltip? leo (a11y): preference for clear verbs too. also screen-reader phrasing matters: if we announce "Checking" repeatedly it gets noisy. prefer aria-live polite for in-progress, and assertive only on final states. propose live region text: ```Connectivity check: Checking network prerequisites. Update: Reachable.``` That reads okay for SR users. maria (prod): nice — jia, can we surface a compact breakdown line under the pill when there's mixed results? e.g., "1/3 probes failed — details" so non-technical users still know it's partial. jia (design): yep — compact row with chevron to expand advanced details. visual idea: pill + short summary line in muted text. clicking `details` expands a list with icons per probe. I'll attach a mock after lunch. :+1: sam (eng): implementation note: expansion will fetch the detailed probe logs on demand to avoid adding latency to the step. also we should persist the last successful probe in local state so refreshing doesn't show "Untested" immediately. leo (a11y): keyboard focus: when user expands the details, focus should move into the panel and trap within until closed (escape to close). panel should have role="dialog" and `aria-modal="false"` (it's not a modal overlay). also make each probe item focusable and announce status changes per item. maria (prod): good call on focus. UX question: if a probe fails but there is an actionable next step (open port, add CIDR), should we show the 'Fix' CTA inline next to the failed probe or keep all remediation guidance in a side panel? jia (design): inline 'Fix' links feel faster for engineers, but may clutter for non-technical users. compromise: show inline compact link for common fixes (e.g., "open port 443") and a "Learn more" that opens the detailed remediation panel. sam (eng): agree. for the inline link we can open a small flyout with the exact commands/snippets, e.g.: ```ssh -p 22 ubuntu@host # open ssh from bastion``` This flyout must be copy-only (no editable code) for safety. leo (a11y): ensure flyout is reachable by keyboard and has label. for copy-only snippets use a copy-to-clipboard button with aria-label="Copy snippet". provide visible focus state. maria (prod): copy polish suggestions: instead of "probe failed" use "Connectivity check failed" and for the success case use "Connectivity check passed". less ambiguous than just 'failed' or 'ok'. also prefer sentence case for help copy. jia (design): noted. will update microcopy spreadsheet: change "Failed" -> "Connectivity check failed" and adjust tone to be helpful not accusatory. sam (eng): edgecase: some environments block outbound telemetry. the current UI tries to fetch KB links and errors out. should we surface a non-blocking banner: "We couldn't fetch troubleshooting docs — details (offline)" so it doesn't look like the whole check failed? maria (prod): yes please. non-blocking banner with a subtle dotted icon. deploy-bot: deploy started for branch `private-wizard-ux` — build #4212 jia (design): quick accessibility nit for color: the 'Unreachable' pill is currently pure red (#e53935) which fails contrast at small sizes. propose darker red or adding a white border for pills on dark backgrounds. leo (a11y): darker red + bold text is fine. additionally include a status icon (X / check / dash) so color isn't the only signal. sam (eng): can we switch to an icon font with accessible labels? e.g., "Unreachable" so screen readers get label + icon combo. jia (design): yes — I'll add icons and verify with a11y plugin. also considering micro-animations for 'Checking' state — spinner inside pill. confirm behavior if user tabs away: animation shouldn't be distracting. maria (prod): final product ask: update the checklist for the network step in the runbook: 1) pill state mapping 2) aria-live rules 3) keyboard/focus behavior 4) inline 'Fix' link behavior 5) offline KB banner 6) persist last probe state locally. assign owners: jia for visuals & copy, leo for a11y sign-off, sam for implementation. target: next sprint grooming. sam (eng): assigning PR once design mock is in Figma. I'll prototype the fetch-on-expand and local persistence. leo (a11y): I'll run a quick NVDA + VoiceOver pass after jia uploads mocks. will double-check aria-live politeness. jia (design): uploading Figma link in ~2h. also will include alternative text for all status icons and a11y checklist notes. :rocket: maria (prod): thanks team! small follow-up — for telemetry, let's add a boolean `user_opted_in_docs_fetch` in state so we can respect environments that block external calls. sam pls note. :memo: sam (eng): noted. I'll add a flag and default to true for hosted; false for private by default. maria (prod): perfect. wrapping up — anyone else? :eyes: leo (a11y): one more tiny wording tweak: change "details" to "View details" for the expand affordance so it's announced as an action. jia (design): done, will update the label. maria (prod): closing thread — thanks! :pray:
